cards.text: Ai, the city Israel just conquered, is a heap of ruins (Joshua 8:28). At that time, Joshua, Israel's leader, builds an altar to the LORD, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal. Now you might think this was Joshua's own idea, but hold that thought.

cards.question: Why does Joshua build an altar to the LORD on Mount Ebal?

answers.text: The LORD's servant Moses had commanded it
The elders of Israel had asked for it
The Levitical priests had asked for it

cards.text: Moses, the servant of the LORD, left instructions in the Book of the Law, and Joshua builds the altar exactly by the Book.

cards.question: Joshua builds the altar the way the Book of the Law says: an altar of ___ stones.

cards.text: Not one iron tool touches the altar's stones, just as the Book says.

cards.question: On the new altar at Mount Ebal, the Israelites offer burnt offerings and peace offerings.

cards.text: Then, right there in front of all the Israelites, Joshua starts writing on the stones. And no, it's not "JOSHUA WAS HERE."

cards.question: What does Joshua write on the stones at Mount Ebal?

answers.text: A copy of the law of Moses
The names of the twelve tribes
A record of the battle at Ai

cards.text: Now picture the crowd. All Israel, with their elders, officers and judges, stands on both sides of the ark of the covenant of the LORD, facing the Levitical priests who carry it.
The crowd is split down the middle. Half stand in front of Mount Gerizim and half in front of Mount Ebal, like an usher at a wedding going, "Bride's side or groom's side?" times a WHOLE nation.

cards.question: There are no foreigners in the crowd standing on both sides of the ark.
Half the people stand in front of Mount Gerizim and half in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses had commanded earlier, to ___ the people of Israel.

cards.text: Afterward, Joshua reads the words of the law OUT LOUD, according to what's written in the Book of the Law.

cards.question: When Joshua reads the law aloud, he reads the blessings and leaves out the curses.

cards.text: Not one word of all Moses commanded gets skipped. Friend, I once watched ONE skipped line on a recipe card turn a whole batch into hockey pucks, so Joshua's got my respect.

cards.question: Joshua reads every word Moses commanded to the whole assembly, foreigners included. Who else does the passage name as right there listening?

answers.text: The women and the little ones
The kings of the nearby cities
